artist.zh: 威廉·安德斯，阿波罗 8 号（NASA）

medium.en: Photograph on colour film, taken from lunar orbit (NASA AS08-14-2383)
medium.zh: 彩色胶片照片，摄于环月轨道（NASA 编号 AS08-14-2383）

basis.en: A NASA photograph, and so a US federal government work, which is not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105).
basis.zh: NASA 拍摄的照片，属于美国联邦政府作品，不受版权保护（《美国法典》第 17 编第 105 条）。

alt.en: The Earth, half lit and half in shadow, hangs in a black sky above the grey, cratered horizon of the Moon.
alt.zh: 地球一半被照亮、一半在阴影中，悬在黑色的天空里，下方是灰色、布满陨坑的月球地平线。

note.en: Taken by the crew of Apollo 8 on 24 December 1968, during their fourth orbit of the Moon, and usually credited to William Anders. It is among the first colour photographs a person took of the Earth from as far away as the Moon, and it changed how many people pictured their own planet. It hangs beside a speech that promised the Moon and, on the way, showed people their home.
note.zh: 1968 年 12 月 24 日，阿波罗 8 号乘组在环绕月球的第四圈时拍下这张照片，通常归功于威廉·安德斯。它是人类最早亲手从月球那么远的地方拍下的地球彩色照片之一，改变了许多人想象自己这颗星球的方式。它挂在一篇许诺登月的演说旁边：那次许诺在途中，先让人们看了一眼自己的家园。
